name: Shenthul
summary: Shenthul is a jungle troll rogue trainer based in the shadowy subterranean reaches of the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. As an operative of the Shattered Hand, he orchestrates espionage operations across Kalimdor and initiates rising rogues into the guild's covert ranks.

sections.title: Eyes in the Chasm
sections.body: Tucked away inside the murky depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul serves as one of the Horde's foremost rogue mentors. While the warriors and shamans above march openly across the red dust of Durotar, Shenthul trains those who prefer stealth, ambush, and subterfuge. Under his tutelage, initiates master essential fieldcraft and lethal arts, learning to operate within the unforgiving politics and harsh wilderness of Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Shattered Hand
sections.body: Shenthul represents the Shattered Hand, an order transformed from an old orcish clan into the Horde's intelligence network and secret service. He views the organization as a timeless, watchful veil blanketing Kalimdor—acting as investigator, judge, jury, and executioner. Fiercely pragmatic and independent of shifting political tides, Shenthul famously reminds outsiders that the Shattered Hand existed long before Warchief Thrall took power and will endure long after him.

sections.title: Covert Fieldwork
sections.body: Beyond basic training, Shenthul coordinates delicate missions into contested territories. His assignments send operatives on perilous infiltration assignments, such as conducting deep-cover operations against hostile interests, monitoring suspicious operations like the Venture Company in Windshear Crag, and testing recruits through demanding clandestine trials. When poisons strike his field agents, Shenthul ensures they secure remedies before fatal consequences take hold.

faq.answer: Shenthul is a jungle troll rogue trainer and operative of the Shattered Hand stationed in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar.
He can be found in the Cleft of Shadow, the subterranean cavern complex accessed through the darker tunnels of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is Shenthul's connection to the Shattered Hand?
faq.answer: Shenthul is a dedicated operative and recruiter for the Shattered Hand, the covert intelligence and assassin guild operating within the Horde.

faq.q: What does Shenthul think of Warchief Thrall?
faq.answer: Shenthul is loyal to the craft and security of the Horde, but maintains that the Order of the Shattered Hand existed before Thrall and will outlast his rule, seeing his guild as an eternal necessity.

faq.q: What missions does Shenthul offer to rogues?
faq.answer: He guides rogues through initiation trials, sends them on covert infiltration missions, and dispatches them to investigate threats such as the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Does Shenthul assist with rogue poisons?
faq.answer: Yes, during crucial field operations where rogues face lethal toxins, Shenthul directs agents to Hinott to ensure survival and ongoing fieldwork.

angles.text: Shenthul is a primary mentor and handler for Horde rogues arriving in Orgrimmar, offering skill training, initiation trials, and covert assignments.
Operating beneath the surface of the capital, Shenthul directs the covert intelligence arm that protects the Horde from unseen internal and external threats.
As a jungle troll embedded deeply in the traditionally orcish Shattered Hand, Shenthul demonstrates how Darkspear rogues have woven themselves into the Horde's highest levels of espionage.
